comparison.objective: Deploy and latch a scissor boom while supporting its tip by a sling and avoiding solar cells; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Sling-only gravity offload and coordinated articulated deployment versus localized tool alignment, hammer-force control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Boom latched at full length, tip at least 1 cm above cells, then released versus four safe fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Different central physical ability and explicit safety outcome.
